modules.name: Layer manifest, provenance and policy-source register
modules.design_question: What single manifest lets any module find, verify, cache, credit, licence-check and datum-check a layer, and trace every value and clause to a hashed source, without opening the data?
modules.method: Extend Vista's release-manifest (per-file bytes, sha256) into manifest.json 'vcm-layers/1' with a JSON Schema. Per layer: id, theme, version; source {publisher, dataset_id, url, retrieved, source_modified, data_owner[]}; licence {id, version, url, accessed, attribution, redistribution}; crs {horizontal, epoch, EPSG; vertical {datum, epsg|null, z_offset_m, basis}}; geometry; lod; accuracy; vintage; bbox; count; fields; files [{path, role, format, bytes, sha256, content_type, range_safe}]; derived_from; build {script, commit}; modules_using; disclaimer_required; status. Licence id is SPDX where listed, else LicenseRef-*; CI derives share_alike from it. Paths are content-addressed (layers/<id>/<sha256[:12]>.<ext>); only manifest.json is fixed (Pages max-age=600). A policy_sources register holds URL, retrieved, bytes, sha256, pages, approved and amended dates for each guideline PDF, council report and policy page. Root LICENSE (MIT or Apache-2.0) covers code only; REUSE.toml plus LICENSES/ maps each data path to its layer licence. CI rejects: missing licence, datum or CRS; hash, byte or path-hash mismatch; file over cap; data path absent from REUSE.toml; ODbL ancestor without share_alike; range_safe true without a browser probe; GeoParquet metadata containing '-dev'; warning or export template lacking the unofficial-estimate text. Every coordinate and height traces to a survey or open-data file; GPT-6 Astra drafts code and text only.
modules.effort: est. 4-5 days (team estimate; adds policy register, REUSE map, CI checks)
modules.human_judgment: Decide which layers ship in the core bundle; choose MIT or Apache-2.0; confirm attribution wording and datum statements with each publisher; choose which policy documents the registry tracks.

modules.name: Storage formats and tiling
modules.design_question: Which format and tiling per layer minimises bytes yet lets the browser load only what the current view needs, while keeping absolute heights for cone tests?
modules.method: Choose format by access pattern. Points and tables (trees, heritage, stations, parcel and tax attributes): GeoParquet 1.1 with explicit geometry column, crs as PROJJSON, bbox covering column, Hilbert sort, zstd; read with hyparquet, passing byteLength from the manifest. Display polygons (parcels, footprints, zoning, parks): PMTiles v3 MVT, about z10-z16 with overzoom; keep the same data as GeoParquet for analysis. LOD1: dissolve City outlines split at parcel lines, then store footprint plus absolute elevations (z_ground_m, z_roof_max_m, z_roof_p50_m), vintage and flags, never baked meshes; derive height_m = z_roof - z_ground for display only; MapLibre fill-extrusion takes height and base in metres. Mark LOD1.3 where tops differ by more than about 2 m. Terrain and canopy rasters: quantised uint16 decimetres or uint8 half-metres as WebP/PNG tiles in PMTiles, or COG, datum in manifest. Hand-modelled meshes: glTF with KHR_mesh_quantization and EXT_meshopt_compression. 3D Tiles only if Cesium is adopted (ellipsoidal heights). View cones: analytic parameters, not meshes. Point clouds: link NRCan COPC, never mirror. Basemap from City layers and LiDAR hillshade; OSM-derived tiles, if wanted, form a separate ODbL layer. Metric work EPSG:3157. Publish a measured size table before committing any layer.
modules.human_judgment: Choose which layers need analysis-grade geometry (Parquet) versus display-only tiles; accept lossy simplification for far context buildings; set the change-detection threshold for 2015 footprints.

modules.name: GitHub hosting, size budgets and range/compression
modules.design_question: How do we host a multi-layer open dataset within GitHub limits while keeping range-read formats working in every target browser?
modules.method: Limits (docs): Pages site 1 GB, deploy timeout 10 minutes, bandwidth soft 100 GB/month; the 10 builds/hour limit does not apply to custom Actions workflows; Pages is not for a free-hosted online business or commercial SaaS. Git warns at 50 MiB, blocks at 100 MiB; releases 2 GiB per file, 1,000 assets, no CORS; LFS free 10 GiB, unusable with Pages. Measured 21 Oct 2026 on the team Pages site: max-age=600, ACAO *, no Access-Control-Expose-Headers; octet-stream and JSON gzip for clients that ask. Chromium 152 sends identity when Range is present: 206 with raw size, no encoding. A browser HEAD returns the gzip Content-Length (2,383,874 versus 9,722,568 raw), which misleads readers that size files from HEAD. Plan: (1) build in CI, deploy with upload-pages-artifact; (2) release zips for citation only; (3) Playwright probe in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit per extension: 206, raw total, magic bytes; curl is diagnostic only; (4) content-addressed paths, previous version kept one cycle; (5) pass byteLength from the manifest; (6) fallback: 1 km shards or a CORS object store.
modules.human_judgment: If Firefox or WebKit probes fail, decide between sharding and a CORS-enabled object store (adds an account and possible cost). If VCM is ever monetised, move off Pages.

modules.name: Local cache and layer subscription
modules.design_question: How do tools subscribe to layers, stay fresh as open data and policy change, and work offline with minimal bandwidth?
modules.method: Subscription is manifest plus versions. The client fetches manifest.json (Pages caches it 10 minutes), compares each layer version and sha256 with its cache, and downloads only changed content-addressed files. Browser cache: Cache Storage or OPFS keyed by sha256, current and previous kept. Desktop/Python: LOCALAPPDATA/vancouver-context/layer/version/ with a lock file. Modules call registry.require and receive a handle plus attribution; they re-render on layer-updated. A weekly Action rebuilds a layer only when the portal modified stamp changes AND the sha256 of the normalised export (sorted, rounded) changes; data_processed is a reprocessing stamp, not a trigger. The portal open-data-change-log dataset is a hint only. The scheduled workflow is disabled after 60 days without repository activity in a public repo, so add a keep-alive and workflow_dispatch. Policy PDFs on guidelines.vancouver.ca return 403 to non-browser clients and the City Terms of Use list repeated automated access among conduct that could overburden the site: policy re-hashing is a person's browser step, recorded by pull request, with a tolerant optional HEAD. Offline mode serves cached layers and shows source dates. Portal exports send ACAO *; never depend on them at runtime.
modules.human_judgment: Set refresh policy per layer; decide whether students may enable live portal fallback; ask the City whether a weekly HEAD on policy PDFs is acceptable.

modules.name: Licence, attribution, non-endorsement and share-alike
modules.design_question: Which licence, attribution and disclaimer does each layer carry, how do we stop ODbL share-alike spreading, and which inherited Vista assets may enter the base?
modules.method: Licence register keyed by layer, ids SPDX or LicenseRef-*. (1) Code: add root LICENSE (MIT or Apache-2.0) to all four repos; none exists; data stays under per-layer licences via manifest and REUSE.toml. (2) OGL-Vancouver v1.0, OGL-Metro Vancouver, OGL-BC 2.0, OGL-Canada 2.0: attribution plus licence link; no official status, no City name, crest or logo. (3) City guidelines and council reports are City copyright, non-commercial copying with Terms-of-Use notice: store transcribed numbers and citations only. (4) OSM and Overture are ODbL: separate files, share_alike, no OSM-City merges, Overture kept out of the city extent; OSM tiles obey the tile policy (no bulk or offline). (5) TransLink GTFS may be redistributed under a limited, revocable licence with legend, identification and indemnity; non-open, outside the open bundle. (6) BC Assessment bulk is not open; the City tax report is co-owned. (7) Vista assets: do not inherit the supplied-model export, terrain, water or shoreline until the supplier's permission and an ODbL classification exist; otherwise rebuild from City footprints, LiDAR and class 5 water. (8) Every warning, surface and export carries: Unofficial estimate, not a City of Vancouver determination. NOTICE and footers are generated from lineage.
modules.human_judgment: Obtain the supplier's written permission and an ODbL classification for the studio model, or drop it; decide whether to unpublish existing Pages exports meanwhile; ask the City and Metro Vancouver about default attribution and the BC Assessment co-owned fields; choose MIT or Apache-2.0.

modules.name: Vertical datum and CRS registry
modules.design_question: How do heights from CGVD28, CGVD28GVRD, CGVD2013, EGM96 and ellipsoid layers, and portal lon/lat labelled WGS84, stay comparable for cone and airspace tests?
modules.method: Every z-bearing file declares z_ref. Known: City LiDAR 2013 CGVD28; 2018 and 2022 CGVD28GVRD (Metro Vancouver geoid HTMVBC00); NRCan HRDEM CGVD2013 in EPSG:3979; Vista SRTM EGM96; 3D Tiles WGS84 ellipsoid; City 2013 DEM and YVR above sea level unnamed; cone heights geodetic, datum unnamed. EPSG: 5713 CGVD28; 9245 CGVD2013a(2010), replacing 6647; 4979; 3157; 4617; 3005 for ParcelMap BC (NAD83 original). Portal WGS84 lon/lat equal NAD83(CSRS) values (tile corners project to round kilometres; a parcel vertex lies 0.113 m from the City UTM corner); EPSG lists 1 m and 2 m NAD83(CSRS) to WGS 84 transformations, so mixing with GNSS, imagery or 3D Tiles needs a declared transform. Estimate z_offset_m by differencing HRDEM VILLE_VANCOUVER (2013-02-19, CGVD2013) against City 2013 LiDAR (February 2013, CGVD28) on bare ground; +0.15 m is a placeholder. Transforms apply on load. Cones defined by a reference roof (9.2, 3.2.4) are tested against LiDAR roof elevations in LiDAR's own datum; geodetic-height cones carry 'cone datum unconfirmed' until the City replies.

modules.name: Trees and canopy layers
modules.design_question: How do we store street trees and canopy compactly while stating height and crown uncertainty honestly?
modules.method: Trees: build cov-public-trees from the portal Parquet export (10,358,425 B raw). Keep asset_id, genus/species dictionary ids, diameter_cm (uint16, 0.1 cm), height class and position (0.1 m, EPSG:3157). Drop or flag 477 zero diameters, 3 zero heights and 1 null geometry. height_m has 84 distinct values but ten classes hold 95.6% of trees (4.6 to 32.0 m); these equal 15 to 105 ft in 10 ft steps, so label them 'recorded class value (inferred 10 ft bins)', uncertainty about plus or minus 1.5 m, never 'measured'. Crown width is not supplied: estimate from diameter and genus (team assumption; calibrate on LiDAR). Canopy: derive a canopy height model from City LiDAR 2022 (class 4, DSM minus DTM) at 2 m, uint8 half-metre tiles; 2013 and 2018 LiDAR give change checks; Metro Vancouver 2020 5 m and 2014 2 m LiDAR land cover are regional cross-checks. Private trees exist only in the CHM. Prototype: 184,267 valid trees pack to 874,891 B (4.75 B each) with zlib-9. Instance one low-poly crown per genus.
modules.human_judgment: Decide the acceptable crown model and whether to request City canopy polygons.

modules.design_question: How do land value, zoning, heritage, transit, traffic, cone parameters, shadow-sensitive spaces and airspace plug into the store without new geometry, and which are safe to use in warnings?
modules.method: Store each future layer as attribute-light tables keyed to existing geometry. Land value: aggregate the 2026 tax report (228,935 folios) by land_coordinate and dissolve parcels by tax_coord before joining; mark strata sums; record BC Assessment as co-owner. Zoning, heritage, transit, traffic locations as before. View-cone parameters (cov-public-views-params): one record per cone component {view_ref, component, definition (geodetic_height | reference_roof | reference_edge), value_m, value_ft, reference_point, status (in_force | proposed | referred_back | superseded | unconfirmed), adopted_by, source_sha256, page, datum_confirmed:false}. The adopted Public Views Guidelines carry no heights, so every numeric height is unconfirmed and drives only a labelled estimate, never a verdict. Solar spaces come from the adopted PDFs, not council drafts. Higher Buildings areas: parameters only. Airspace: SOR/80-902 parameters only, unconfirmed, excluded from warnings until Plan BC 1280 and the 2026 proposed-limit map are obtained. TransLink GTFS: optional client-side fetch with legend; never in the open bundle.
modules.human_judgment: Order the layers by Tall Challenge needs; ask Transport Canada for Plan BC 1280 and the proposed-limit map; ask views@vancouver.ca which cone heights are in force, their datum, and the meaning of 'measured from'.

sources.title: Fetch Standard: HTTP-network-or-cache fetch

flags.claim: City tree data has a height-range field
flags.detail: Current schema has height_m and diameter_cm doubles; no height_range_id.
flags.correction: Use height_m, but treat as class midpoints: 84 values, ten classes hold 95.6%.

flags.claim: GitHub Pages serves any file with usable range requests
flags.detail: application/octet-stream and JSON are gzip-encoded; browser range requests return gzip-stream bytes.
flags.correction: Probe every extension; default to whole-file GETs up to 20 MB; shard or use another host if probes fail. (Superseded r1: the gzip-bytes claim was wrong for browsers; see next range flag.)

flags.claim: Release assets can feed the browser viewer
flags.detail: Neither the 302 hop nor the final asset host returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
flags.correction: Use releases for archives and CI; serve browser data from Pages.

flags.claim: Git LFS can hold Pages data
flags.detail: GitHub docs state LFS cannot be used with Pages; free quota is 10 GiB.
flags.correction: Build in CI and deploy by artifact; no LFS.

flags.claim: BC Assessment values are open data
flags.detail: Bulk data is sold under licence (search snippet, unopened).
flags.correction: Use City property tax report under OGL-Vancouver. (r2: the report lists BC Assessment as co-owner; the row now records data_owner and asks the City to confirm.)

flags.claim: TransLink data is open under an OGL
flags.detail: Terms are limited, revocable, with legend and approval.
flags.correction: Treat as optional, fetched at runtime, never mirrored. (Superseded r2: GTFS static terms permit redistribution with a legend; see the r2 TransLink flag.)

flags.claim: City portal offers canopy rasters and traffic volumes
flags.detail: None among 200 datasets; traffic datasets hold locations and VanMap links only.
flags.correction: Derive canopy from LiDAR; mark volumes unresolved.

flags.claim: Mixing OSM heights into City footprints is acceptable (Vista practice)
flags.detail: Merged data can be an ODbL derivative database.
flags.correction: Separate ODbL layers; choose City+LiDAR or OSM per feature type and extent.

flags.claim: OGL-Vancouver default attribution wording (RESOLVED r1)
flags.detail: Licence page text read in a browser 21 Oct 2026: version 1.0, based on OGL-BC 2.0.
flags.correction: Verified wording: 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver.' Metro Vancouver pattern also read. Re-read r2 with the non-endorsement and versioning clauses.

flags.claim: .parquet, .pmtiles, .fgb files get no gzip on Pages
flags.detail: Only .fgb tested r1 (flatgeobuf.org on GitHub Pages): curl gzip gets gzip; browser Range gets raw bytes. .parquet and .pmtiles untested; an r2 fetch of a protomaps.github.io sample failed.
flags.correction: Run the Playwright one-file probe per extension and browser before committing.

flags.claim: Cone heights share a datum with City LiDAR
flags.detail: Council reports give geodetic heights 'measured from' corners with NAD 1983 UTM 10N coordinates; vertical datum unnamed. The adopted guidelines say only 'maximum geodetic height permitted'.
flags.correction: Ask the City; carry a datum-unconfirmed flag.

flags.claim: Size budgets and byte estimates
flags.detail: 400 MB site, 20 MB file, 5 MB first load, 40 B per building are ours; r1 prototypes measured trees (4.75 B) and footprint geometry (15.9-20 B) in memory only.
flags.correction: Measure Parquet and PMTiles after first build.

flags.claim: Crown width can be estimated from diameter and genus
flags.detail: No crown data in the portal.
flags.correction: Calibrate against LiDAR canopy height.

flags.claim: GPT-6 Astra released September 2026
flags.detail: Only secondary press reports found; irrelevant to this store.
flags.correction: Keep survey data as geography source; model drafts code and text only.

flags.claim: On GitHub Pages a browser Range request returns gzip-stream bytes, so range reads of octet-stream/JSON are broken
flags.detail: Fetch standard sends Accept-Encoding: identity with Range. Chromium 152 fetch on the team's site: 206, Content-Range 0-99/9722568, no Content-Encoding. Only curl with gzip gets gzip ranges.
flags.correction: Gate range_safe on a Playwright browser probe; Firefox and WebKit untested. Whole-file GETs still gain from gzip. Browser HEAD returns gzip Content-Length, so pass byteLength from the manifest.

flags.claim: NRCan HRDEM is in UTM NAD83(CSRS) and Vancouver coverage is not confirmed
flags.detail: STAC says reprojected to EPSG:3979; items cover downtown (VILLE_VANCOUVER 2013, Lower Mainland 2016) and the North Shore (Sunshine Coast 2018); COGs on S3 return 206 with ACAO *.
flags.correction: Record EPSG:3979, CGVD2013, project id per tile; range-read COGs offline or in CI.

flags.claim: EPSG:6647 is the code for current CGVD2013 heights
flags.detail: EPSG:9245 CGVD2013a(2010) height replaces CGVD2013(CGG2013) height (6647).
flags.correction: Register 9245 and 6647; record geoid realisation (CGG2013 versus CGG2013a) per layer.

flags.claim: SOR/80-902 parameters (45 m above a 2 m ARP, about 47 m; 1:50; 1:7) are enough to generate the YVR height ceiling
flags.detail: Extent is only on Plan BC 1280 sheets 1-32 (1978); Part II follows the Richmond-Vancouver boundary; 2026 proposed Vancouver and Burnaby limits are mapped only on request.
flags.correction: Obtain plans and the proposed-limit map; keep the layer 'unconfirmed' and out of compliance warnings.

flags.claim: The 10 builds/hour soft limit constrains the deploy design
flags.detail: GitHub docs: the limit does not apply to sites built and published with a custom Actions workflow.
flags.correction: Drop it; relevant limits are 1 GB site, 10-minute deploy timeout and 100 GB/month bandwidth.

flags.claim: Rapid transit stations layer = 22 stations
flags.detail: 22 rows include duplicates (Waterfront x2, Commercial - Broadway x2): 20 unique names; no Broadway Subway stations.
flags.correction: Count deduplicated stations; add planned stations separately (BC government: six new stations, fall 2027).

flags.claim: Portal lon/lat labelled WGS84 are WGS84 values
flags.detail: LiDAR tile corners project to round UTM kilometres with no datum shift; a parcel vertex matches the City's UTM corner within 0.113 m. Values are NAD83(CSRS) numerically.
flags.correction: Label NAD83(CSRS) (EPSG:4617/3157); write PROJJSON crs; declare any transform to true WGS84 (EPSG lists 1-2 m).

flags.claim: Relative height_m and base_m are enough for cone and viewpoint tests
flags.detail: Cones use geodetic heights; 'above local ground' is undefined on slopes.
flags.correction: Store z_ground_m, z_roof_max_m, z_roof_p50_m, height_basis, vintage in a declared datum; derive height_m for display.

flags.claim: City 2015 footprints plus LiDAR 2022 heights give a current LOD1 context
flags.detail: Footprints are 2015 and not updated; 4,635 New Building permits issued since 1 Sep 2022 and 7,162 demolition permits since 2017.
flags.correction: Run change detection against LiDAR class 6, add footprints traced from LiDAR, show vintage and a 'context newer than 2022 not modelled' notice.

flags.claim: ODbL separation applies to buildings only; Vista terrain and water are free of OSM
flags.detail: Vista terrain is clipped by OSM coast and water; water, shoreline and extension buildings are OSM; the model is noted as built from 2022 OSM data.
flags.correction: Validate every inherited asset's derived_from; flag ODbL or rebuild coast and water from LiDAR class 5.

flags.claim: Overture lists City of Vancouver as a building source
flags.detail: The buildings guide lists it; the attribution page does not. Critique said it was unlisted; r1 found it in the guide. r2 re-checked: conflict stands.
flags.correction: Keep claim with citation; keep Overture out of the city-extent building layer (City-origin geometry would become ODbL); ask Overture which City release feeds the theme.

flags.claim: Clause numbers cited from the Public Views Guidelines
flags.detail: r2: adopted PDF read. It prints clauses 3.1.1-3.1.5 under heading 3.2 (pp. 6-7), 3.3.1-3.3.4 under 3.3 (p. 7) and 3.4.1-3.4.8 under 3.4 (pp. 7-8), the same irregular numbering as RTS 16338 App A.
flags.correction: Cite as 'cl. 3.1.1 (under heading 3.2), p. 6' with the PDF sha256; the numbering irregularity persists.

flags.claim: TransLink data requires permission and cannot be redistributed (redistribution: permission)
flags.detail: GTFS static terms grant a limited, revocable, non-exclusive licence to use, reproduce and redistribute, with a legend, identification on request, indemnity and possible extra terms for fee-charging users. No API key or approval is mentioned for static data. TransLink retains rights to modifications.
flags.correction: Set redistribution to permitted_revocable_nonopen; keep GTFS outside the open bundle and NOTICE licence pool; show the legend; accept the indemnity knowingly. Open API terms were not re-read.

flags.claim: ParcelMap BC Parcel Polygons (open) are NAD83(CSRS)
flags.detail: The catalogue record says a 30 Jan 2022 reprojection from NAD83(CSRS)/BC Albers (EPSG 3153) produced this NAD83/BC Albers (EPSG 3005) product with NTv2 grids. Published deviation versus the prior product: median 0.056 m, mean 0.081 m, max 21.43 m, 536 of 1,669,316 over 1 m.
flags.correction: Register EPSG:3005; declare an NAD83 to NAD83(CSRS) transform before comparing with City data. Do not assume a 0.5-1 m offset: the published median is 0.056 m.

flags.claim: LidarBC is licensed OGL-BC (no qualification)
flags.detail: CKAN license_title is 'Access Only' (license_id 22) while the notes say the data is released under OGL-BC; record modified 2024-04-18; five contributors.
flags.correction: Record both, set status licence_conflict, ask LiDAR@gov.bc.ca and check per-tile metadata before deriving or shipping any LidarBC product.

flags.claim: Vista's central context is credited correctly, with OSM credit needed only for buildings outside the supplied model
flags.detail: unified_manifest says central buildings retain supplied OSM footprint meshes; extension_manifest and generated/manifest say the model is OSM-derived from a 2022 extract. README line 59 credits OSM only outside the model. The supplier of 'Vancouver DT context.3dm' and its redistribution rights are undocumented; the export is public on Pages and reused in program-value-visualizer/basemap.
flags.correction: Do not inherit the export, terrain, water or shoreline until written supplier permission and an ODbL classification exist; credit '© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL' for the central model in Vista; add the basemap to the lineage audit; otherwise rebuild from City footprints, LiDAR and class 5 water.

flags.claim: Outside Downtown solar rule covers spring and fall equinoxes; Downtown times are PDT (from council drafts RTS 16338 App C and RTS 16506 App A)
flags.detail: Adopted Outside Downtown PDF (amended 4 Feb 2026) cl. 3.1.1 names the fall equinox only, 10 a.m.-4 p.m. PDT. Adopted Downtown PDF (approved 17 Sep 2025, amended 29 Jul 2026) uses PT (UTC-7) and adds Davie and Robson Village sidewalks and Victory Square.
flags.correction: Source solar parameters to the adopted PDFs by hash and amendment date; keep council reports as history.

flags.claim: The adopted Public Views Guidelines PDF may hold per-view cone heights, geometry or diagrams (222 KB listing)
flags.detail: The adopted PDF is 8 pages (210,961 B) with Table 1 and clauses only; no heights or coordinates. Heights sit in council report appendices; per-view City pages hold origin, subject and images; the City GIS cone model is not public and site assessments are on request.
flags.correction: Treat every numeric cone height as unconfirmed with status and evidence; cite the adopted PDF only for clause text and the view list.

flags.claim: Council reports and guideline PDFs carry no licence terms, so a facts-only id suffices
flags.detail: The City Terms of Use state that bylaw, council and policy copies are City copyright, not official versions, cannot be distributed or used commercially, and may be copied non-commercially with the Terms notice and URL.
flags.correction: Use LicenseRef-CoV-ToU-noncommercial with redistribution noncommercial_notice (documents) or facts_only (transcribed numbers); store citations, not PDF text or figures.

flags.claim: A weekly Action can fetch and re-hash policy PDFs on guidelines.vancouver.ca
flags.detail: curl and WebFetch get HTTP 403 while a browser page fetch succeeds; Terms of Use list repeated automated access among conduct that could overburden the site; scheduled workflows also stop after 60 days of repository inactivity.
flags.correction: Make policy re-hashing a person's browser step recorded by pull request; keep any CI HEAD optional and 403-tolerant; add keep-alive.

flags.claim: RTS 19750 (2611 Victoria Drive, 83 m, view 27.1, Trout Lake amendments referred back) at council.vancouver.ca/20260728/documents/r26.pdf
flags.detail: r26.pdf is RTS 19748 (road closure at 961 W 19th Ave, 5 pages). RTS 18459 (r2.pdf) has no Trout Lake text. The report was not located in r2.
flags.correction: Demote the 2611 Victoria Drive site check and the referred-back claim to unverified until the correct report is found.

flags.claim: Portal data_processed signals a content change, so it can trigger rebuilds and update toasts
flags.detail: Footprints: modified 2022-06-09 but data_processed 2026-10-20; the change-log has one row (2022-06-09).
flags.correction: Trigger on modified plus the sha256 of the normalised export; use the change-log as a hint only.

flags.claim: OSM standard raster tiles are an acceptable basemap for VCM and form-studio
flags.detail: form-studio loads tile.openstreetmap.org. The tile policy forbids bulk download, prefetch and offline use, requires visible attribution and a valid Referer, and may withdraw access.
flags.correction: Use City layers and LiDAR hillshade, or a self-hosted OSM-derived PMTiles layer flagged ODbL with credit.

flags.claim: A .reuse/dep5 file is the way to map data paths to licences (critique fix)
flags.detail: REUSE spec 3.3 marks DEP5 deprecated and forbids combining it with REUSE.toml.
flags.correction: Use REUSE.toml [[annotations]] with path globs plus LICENSES/ files.

flags.claim: Which cone heights are in force
flags.detail: RTS 18292 App A lists 27.1 59.8 m and 27.2 54.3 m under 'Current' and 68.9 m for 27.2 as proposed; adopted Table 1 marks 27.1 and 27.2 'Amended 2026' and 28 approved 2026; RTS 18120 App K (H 58 m, J2 east 43.5 m) is 'subject to refinement' and Table 1 marks J2 amended 2025 but not H.
flags.correction: Record every height as unconfirmed with evidence; ask views@vancouver.ca for the in-force table and datum.
